_comment: BATCH 5 - Chapter 5, the largest chapter. Faithful transfer only.

entries.match: Your task is not to seek for love
entries.notes: Audit: quote-site attestation only. No scholarly source located; not checked against the Persian corpus or Barks's renderings. Note the manuscript elsewhere labels a Barks-derived line honestly as 'Adapted from Rumi, after Coleman Barks'; this one carries a bare byline.
Truncated from a longer sentence but accurate.

Audit: source is right, wording is a modern contraction. Plutarch's analogy is WOOD THAT NEEDS IGNITING, not a fire to be kindled - Waterfield (Penguin 1992) 'not a vessel that needs filling, but wood that needs igniting'; Loeb (1927) 'does not require filling like a bottle, but...'

entries.match: From a spark to a flame
entries.notes: Audit: no source located. He used flame and candle imagery extensively, but this sentence is not among his located writings or talks.

entries.match: flame that burns within each of us
entries.notes: Audit: no source located, including in the Ram Dass archives. Related genuine material exists ('In each of us there once was a fire'; 'As you find the light in you, you begin to see the light in everyone else') but not this sentence. Part of the Chapter 5 opening pair flagged UNVERIFIED + INTERNAL-ORIGIN CANDIDATE.

entries.work: The Power of Myth (recorded wordings differ)
entries.notes: Audit: the idea is unmistakably Campbell's, but this is the popularized contraction. Recorded wordings run 'follow your bliss and don't be afraid, and doors will open where you didn't know they were going to be'. The 'universe... only walls' form is not among them.

Audit: quote-site attestation only; no talk, lecture, book or interview located. Circulates widely outside this manuscript, so there is NO local-coinage evidence - UNKNOWN, not INTERNAL-ORIGIN CANDIDATE. Two of five McKenna quotations sit unresolved.

Audit: SAME-AUTHOR DISTORTION. The verified letter reads 'For us believing physicists, the separation between past, present and future has only the meaning of an illusion, albeit a tenacious one.' The circulating version changes the subject from TIME to REALITY - a material change of meaning, and it is the changed meaning the chapter relies on.

entries.match: with our passions, as it is with fire
entries.actual_author: unknown - no Aesopic fable contains it
entries.notes: Audit: UNVERIFIED + UNKNOWN. Appears in Bartleby's Proverbs, Maxims and Phrases of All Ages under 'Passions', and circulates in a second form. Aesop policy settled: 'Aesop' as verbatim historical speaker has a low ceiling; verification to a textual tradition is not verification as a historical person's words.

Audit ALREADY CLOSED THIS: 'attributed to Sharon Salzberg - MISATTRIBUTED to Mary Oliver.' The first sentence is verbatim Oliver, the opening of her poem. My Stage-4 speaker sweep recorded this as a new lead; it was not new. The data was already in the census.

Audit: UNVERIFIED - source lead unresolved. The attribution is not in doubt, but the located language sits in No Greater Love, which carries a passage on a lamp burning 'through the continuous input of small drops of oil'. The manuscript's sentence reads as a compression, which would make it PARAPHRASE/ADAPTED on confirmation.

entries.bibliography_relationship: bibliography hedges honestly - '(As cited in collected interviews and writings.)'
entries.notes: Audit: circulates widely as Magritte; no specific interview or writing located. The bibliography's hedge is the appropriate form when no specific source is found.

entries.match: universe is a communion of subjects
entries.work: stated repeatedly across The Dream of the Earth, The Universe Story, The Great Work
entries.bibliography_relationship: Ch5 choice of The Great Work should be confirmed as a text where the sentence appears
entries.notes: Audit: Berry's signature formulation; attribution sound.

entries.match: As long as the ego runs your life
entries.work: A New Earth (2005), confirmed on Tolle's own official channels
entries.bibliography_relationship: MISSING - Ch5 bibliography carries no Tolle entry at all

entries.work: letter to Fanny Bowditch, Letters Vol. 1, p. 33 (Princeton UP, 1973)
entries.notes: Audit: genuine. The manuscript drops an intervening sentence ('Without, everything seems discordant; only within does it coalesce into unity') but what remains is accurate. Contrast with the reclaimed L846 item - a genuine Jung sentence yields a clean primary trail.

entries.match: best way to predict the future
entries.actual_author: Dennis Gabor / Alan Kay, not Peter Drucker
entries.work: Gabor, Inventing the Future (1963): 'The future cannot be predicted, but futures can be invented'
entries.notes: Audit: Alan Kay states he coined the popular form - 'the best way to predict the future is to invent it' - from 1971. The Drucker ascription, with CREATE replacing INVENT, appears by 1986.

entries.work: Codex Atlanticus, notes on types of knowledge
entries.notes: Audit: closed by EDITION CHECK, not by general search. Museo Galileo's Leonardo project renders the thought as essentially 'a good man possesses a natural desire to know'.

entries.match: wound is the place where the Light enters
entries.notes: Audit: PARAPHRASE/ADAPTED, and THE MANUSCRIPT'S OWN LABEL IS ALREADY CORRECT. Barks reads 'That's where the light enters you'; the circulated Persian form is zakhm ja-ye vorud-e nur ast. This is the specimen of honest labelling the other Barks items were measured against.

entries.match: unexamined life is not worth living
entries.bibliography_relationship: MISSING - Ch5 bibliography carries no Plato entry

entries.work: earliest documented ascription: Harold Whittle Blakeley, The 32d Infantry Division in World War II (1956), p. 3
entries.notes: Audit: an American divisional history published 27 years after Foch's death. No French primary source located.

entries.match: May the light of your soul guide you
entries.work: Anam Cara: A Book of Celtic Wisdom (1997) - the opening line of the blessing
entries.notes: Audit: a benediction is a poetic work and O'Donohue died in 2008. Only one line is quoted, which is modest, but the form raises the rights profile.

historical_entries.notes: Audit: UNVERIFIED + INTERNAL-ORIGIN CANDIDATE, the Chapter 5 opening pair. Resolved by authorial ruling at Stage 3: the words are the author's. Removed as redundant with the opening prose.
